svg.aria-label: How I work. Run it: Each project runs from a clone. Every number in a README came from a run on my machine. Measure it: Baselines that could win, held-out sets, and tests that prove the claim, not the demo. Say what was not verified: Simulated data, emulators, services I had no account for: each README lists them.
